senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) fruit, produce; fruition, usufruct; profit, interest.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 6:1">Ber. VI, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Berakhot 35a:1">35ᵃ</cite>) <he>על פירות … בורא פְּ׳ העץ</he> over fruits of trees you must say, (blessed be thou &c.) who hast created the fruit of the tree; <he>על פירות הארץ … בורא פ׳ האדמה</he> over growths from the ground you must say; … who hast created the products of the soil.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:21">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> <he>הפירי</he>, v. <cite ref="B00480"><he>בָּחַל</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 79a:6">Ḥull. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ עם האם</he> the copulation of a hybrid issue with its mother; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01741"><he>פִּרוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00006"><he>פֵּי׳</he></cite>. Ber. l. c., v. supra.
<cite ref="Gittin 47b:8">Gitt. 47ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>המוכר שדהו לפ׳</he> if a man sells his field for the usufruct (for a number of years).
<cite ref="Gittin 47b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>קנין פ׳ כקנין הגיף דמי</he> possession of the usufruct is like ownership of a field (for the time being).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 9:1">Keth. IX, 1</cite> <he>הרי זה אוכל פ׳ בחייה</he> he has the usufruct (of her property) during her lifetime.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 9:1">Ib.</cite> <he>פֵּירֵי פ׳</he> (<cite ref="Q00856"><he>פֵּרֵי</he></cite>) the usufruct of the produce of the produce, i.e. of the income invested.

<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 1:1">Peah I, 1</cite> <he>אלו דברים שאדם אוכל פּירוֹתֵיהֶן וכ׳</he> these are the things of which a man enjoys the interest (for which man is rewarded) in this world, whereas the principal remains for the hereafter.

<cite ref="Tosefta Peah 1:2">Tosef. ib. I, 2</cite> <he>זכות יש לה קרן ויש לה פ׳</he> a good deed yields a principal (for the hereafter), and bears interest (in this world); <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 1:3">ib. 3</cite> <he>עבירה יש לה קרן ואין לה פ׳</he> sin creates a capital, but bears no interest; <he>עבירה שעושה פ׳ יש לה פ׳</he> a sin which bears fruit (influences other people for bad) bears fruit (is punished in this world); <cite ref="Kiddushin 40a:10">Kidd. 40ᵃ</cite>; a. v. fr.—Midr. Sam. ch. IV <he>פְּרָיִין שלו</he> its fruits.
